xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5062: dbt projects: placeholders in gate env, identifier-safe feature placeholder, per-workspace dev target

plan.title: dbt projects: placeholders in gate env, identifier-safe feature placeholder, per-workspace dev target
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: dbt projects cannot run cleanly through the pipeline. gate.env values are passed raw, so env: { DBT_SCHEMA: "dev_{{FEATURE_NAME}}" } reaches dbt literally. FEATURE_NAME contains hyphens (min-574), which are invalid in unquoted SQL identifiers. The rendered workspace .env is never loaded into agent shells or gates, and dbt env_var() reads only the process environment, so an agent's dbt build cannot target its own dev schema. The docs have no recipe and list only three gate placeholders.
narratives.Proposal: Add a required FEATURE_IDENT placeholder (lowercase, every char outside [a-z0-9_] becomes _) at all six placeholder construction sites. Render gate.env values with the gate's placeholders once per gate and use the result for both the host env and container -e flags. Add an opt-in workspace.env.load switch: a new src/lib/workspace-env.ts parses the rendered workspace .env (never sources it), drops reserved keys, and feeds host gates (precedence process < workspace .env < gate.env) and agent launchers (quoted exports emitted inside generateLauncherScript right after SKIP_DOCS_INDEX, skipped for project roots and remote launches). Document a dbt / data-projects recipe in configuration/projects.mdx and list FEATURE_IDENT and env.load in polyrepo.mdx and docs/CONFIGURATION.md. Full detail, before/after snippets and file anchors are in .pan/drafts/PAN-5062.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Cloning or dropping a warehouse database per workspace (Hume create/teardown pattern)
- Per-project credentials and MCP servers (filed separately)
- Passing gate.env or the workspace .env to remote (Fly ssh) gates
- Passing the workspace .env to container gates
- Changing container docker exec -e quoting (stays -e K="v")
- Wiring, repurposing or removing the dead workspace.env.secrets_file field
- Re-rendering <workspace>/.env for workspaces created before env.template changed
- Loading the workspace .env by default (it stays opt-in via env.load)
- Sourcing the .env file with the shell
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt cap
- Installing or invoking dbt, DuckDB, Snowflake or Docker in any test

autoDecisions.summary: FEATURE_IDENT is a required field of TemplatePlaceholders, not optional
autoDecisions.rationale: A required field makes npm run typecheck fail at any construction site that forgets it, which mechanically enforces 'available everywhere placeholders are'.

autoDecisions.summary: FEATURE_IDENT = FEATURE_NAME.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_]/g, '_'), one char in one char out, no collapsing or leading-digit handling
autoDecisions.rationale: Plain reading of the issue (hyphens and dots become _, lowercase). Docs tell users to use it after a prefix (dev_{{FEATURE_IDENT}}), which also covers digit-leading names.

autoDecisions.summary: Workspace .env loading is opt-in via workspace.env.load: true, default off
autoDecisions.rationale: Existing env.template projects would otherwise start exporting values such as PORT or COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME into agent shells and gates, a silent behavior change.

autoDecisions.summary: Host gate env precedence is process.env (filtered) < workspace .env < rendered gate.env
autoDecisions.rationale: gate.env is the most specific config and must win; the workspace .env is per-workspace and beats the dashboard's inherited env.

autoDecisions.summary: The workspace .env is parsed (KEY=value) and emitted through shellQuote, never sourced; OVERDECK_*, PATH and HOME keys are dropped
autoDecisions.rationale: Compose-style .env values are not valid shell and sourcing executes them; reserved keys would break agent identity, tool resolution or gate determinism.

autoDecisions.summary: Agent loading is one call inside generateLauncherScript (after SKIP_DOCS_INDEX), with all logic in src/lib/workspace-env.ts
autoDecisions.rationale: There are 15 generateLauncherScript call sites (spawn, resume, recovery x5, messaging, conversations, planning); one generator call covers all of them, and the generator has 3 lines of headroom under the 1000-line ceiling.

autoDecisions.summary: Agent loading skips project roots and spawnMode 'remote'
autoDecisions.rationale: Conversations launch in the project root, whose .env Overdeck did not render; remote working dirs do not exist on this host.

autoDecisions.summary: Container -e quoting is unchanged and container/remote gates do not get the workspace .env
autoDecisions.rationale: Single-quoting would stop host $VAR expansion existing configs may rely on; containers get env from compose; remote gates never received gate.env either.

autoDecisions.summary: Recipe gate names are dbt-parse and dbt-build
autoDecisions.rationale: selectLocalVerificationGates drops a gate named exactly 'test' from the local run when verification.tests resolves to ci.

metadata.sizeJustification: One user-facing capability (dbt-ready gates and per-workspace dev target) whose three code changes share TemplatePlaceholders, QualityGateRunOptions and the new workspace-env module; splitting into sibling issues would ship a placeholder no gate env can use, or an env switch with no identifier-safe value to put in it.

items.title: Add the FEATURE_IDENT placeholder at every placeholder construction site

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. In src/lib/workspace-config.ts add a required `FEATURE_IDENT: string;` to `export interface TemplatePlaceholders` (after FEATURE_NAME, with a PAN-5062 comment) and an exported `toFeatureIdent(featureName: string): string` directly above `replacePlaceholders`, returning `featureName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_]/g, '_')`. Set FEATURE_IDENT next to FEATURE_NAME at the five other construction sites: createWorkspacePlaceholders in src/lib/workspace/devcontainer-renderer.ts (`toFeatureIdent(featureName)`), the `const placeholders: TemplatePlaceholders = {` literal in src/lib/cloister/verification-runner.ts (~406, `toFeatureIdent(featureName)`), the `const gatePlaceholders = {` literal in src/dashboard/server/routes/workspaces/merge-ops.ts (~650), the placeholders literal in src/lib/test-runner.ts (~299, `toFeatureIdent(featureName || 'main')`), and `function buildPlaceholders(` in src/lib/lifecycle/teardown-workspace.ts (`toFeatureIdent(issueLower)`). Leave src/dashboard/server/routes/workspaces.ts ~1039 alone (port map, not TemplatePlaceholders). Add tests: new tests/unit/lib/workspace-config-feature-ident.test.ts and one assertion in the existing createWorkspacePlaceholders describe of src/lib/workspace/__tests__/ensure-devcontainer.test.ts. merge-ops.ts is over 1000 lines (cap 1835) and may grow by one line only.

Render gate.env placeholders for host and container quality gates

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. In runQualityGates (src/lib/cloister/validation.ts), right after `const command = opts.placeholders ? replacePlaceholders(gate.command, ...) : gate.command;` (~323), compute `const gateEnv = gate.env && opts.placeholders ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(gate.env).map(([k, v]) => [k, replacePlaceholders(v, opts.placeholders!)])) : gate.env;` with a PAN-5062 comment. Use gateEnv in the container `envFlags` map (~391; keep the `-e ${k}="${v}"` quoting) and in `buildQualityGateEnv(gateEnv)` (~456). Remote (fly ssh) path unchanged. In tests/cloister/verification-gate.test.ts (exec is mocked) add FEATURE_IDENT: 'pan_1' to the PAN-666 placeholders fixture and add three tests: host env rendering, container -e rendering (first execMock call resolves the docker ps liveness stdout 'proj-feature-pan-1-dbt\n'), and literal pass-through without placeholders.

items.title: Given a host gate with env { DBT_SCHEMA: 'dev_{{FEATURE_IDENT}}' } and a substitution map whose FEATURE_IDENT is 'pan_1', when runQualityGates runs it, then the exec call's options.env.DBT_SCHEMA equals 'dev_pan_1'

Given a container gate with container_name 'proj-{{FEATURE_FOLDER}}-dbt' and the same env, when runQualityGates runs it against a live container, then the docker exec command contains '-e DBT_SCHEMA="dev_pan_1"' and contains no '{{'

Add the workspace-env module and the workspace.env.load config field

expected_outputs: circular-dependency lint reports no new cycle
file-size guard reports no violations (projects.ts does not grow)

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3. Create src/lib/workspace-env.ts exporting parseWorkspaceEnv(content), readWorkspaceEnv(workspacePath), loadWorkspaceEnvForProject(project, workspacePath) and workspaceEnvLauncherLines(workingDir, findProject = findProjectByPath). parseWorkspaceEnv: trim each line, skip blank and '#' lines, strip an optional leading 'export ', match ^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(.*)$, strip one pair of matching surrounding quotes, drop keys matching /^OVERDECK_/ plus PATH and HOME, ignore non-matching lines. readWorkspaceEnv returns {} when <workspacePath>/.env is missing. loadWorkspaceEnvForProject returns {} unless project?.workspace?.env?.load === true and resolve(workspacePath) !== resolve(project.path). workspaceEnvLauncherLines checks existsSync(<workingDir>/.env) first (returns [] without a project lookup), then maps loadWorkspaceEnvForProject(findProject(workingDir), workingDir) to `export ${k}=${shellQuote(v)}` lines (shellQuote from src/lib/shell-quote.ts). Add `load?: boolean` with a PAN-5062 doc comment to `export interface EnvConfig` in src/lib/workspace-config.ts, and add `load?: boolean` on the same line of the inline env type in src/lib/projects.ts (grep `env?: { template?: string; secrets_file?: string }`; projects.ts is over 1000 lines and must not grow). No child processes. Tests in tests/unit/lib/workspace-env.test.ts use temp dirs and fake values only.

items.title: Given .env content with a comment, an 'export ' prefix, quoted values, 'URL=http://x?a=1&b=2', and OVERDECK_AGENT_ID/PATH/HOME keys, when parseWorkspaceEnv runs, then it returns the unquoted values, keeps the URL literally and drops the three reserved keys

Given a project without env.load, or a workspacePath equal to project.path, when loadWorkspaceEnvForProject runs, then it returns {}; given env.load true and a workspace .env, then it returns the parsed map

Given an opted-in workspace .env with DBT_SCHEMA=dev_min_574 and a value containing a single quote, '&' and a space, when workspaceEnvLauncherLines runs with an injected findProject, then it returns "export DBT_SCHEMA='dev_min_574'" and a shell-quoted line that bash evaluates back to the original value
Given a workingDir with no .env file, when workspaceEnvLauncherLines runs, then it returns [] and the injected findProject is never called
Merge the opted-in workspace .env into host quality gate environments

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4. Add `workspaceEnv?: Record<string, string>` (PAN-5062 doc comment: host gates only) to QualityGateRunOptions in src/lib/cloister/validation.ts. Change buildQualityGateEnv to (gateEnv, workspaceEnv?) returning { SKIP_DOCS_INDEX: '1', ...env, ...workspaceEnv, ...gateEnv }, and make the DASHBOARD_RUNTIME_ENV_KEYS deletion keep a key that either workspaceEnv or gateEnv sets. Pass opts.workspaceEnv only on the host path (container envFlags and the remote fly ssh path do not use it). In src/lib/cloister/verification-runner.ts add `workspaceEnv: loadWorkspaceEnvForProject(projectConfig, workspacePath)` to the runQualityGates options (~501); do the same in the runQualityGates call in src/dashboard/server/routes/workspaces/merge-ops.ts (~682). Keep verification-runner.ts at or under 1000 lines. Tests in tests/cloister/verification-gate.test.ts with fake values.

items.title: Given workspaceEnv { DBT_SCHEMA: 'ws', DBT_TARGET: 'dev' } and gate env { DBT_SCHEMA: 'gate' }, when a host gate runs, then the exec env has DBT_SCHEMA 'gate' and DBT_TARGET 'dev'

In src/lib/launcher-generator.ts add `import { workspaceEnvLauncherLines } from './workspace-env.js';` and, directly after `lines.push('export SKIP_DOCS_INDEX=1');`, the single line `if (config.spawnMode !== 'remote') lines.push(...workspaceEnvLauncherLines(config.workingDir)); // PAN-5062`. The file is 997 lines and the ceiling is 1000. []));`. Never raise an allowlist cap.
